-75.46190,40.06810.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Isaac E. Sasson, MD, PHD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

107.14507,-6.25531.name: Dexa Laboratories of Biomolecular Sciences (DLBS)
107.14507,-6.25531.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Dexa Medica Group. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

78.34000,17.34500.name: Bharat Biotech
78.34000,17.34500.desc: An Indian vaccine manufacturer producing at a volume few companies anywhere match, including recombinant and viral-vector products. Manufacturing capacity in the global south changes who gets treated during a shortage far more than any patent pledge does — during the pandemic that distinction was the whole argument.

-77.00450,38.89080.name: Association for Molecular Pathology v. Myriad — a gene as found cannot be
-77.00450,38.89080.state: Washington DC — Supreme Court of the United States
-77.00450,38.89080.desc: The US Supreme Court held unanimously in 2013 that a naturally occurring DNA sequence is a product of nature and not patentable merely because it has been isolated, while cDNA made in a laboratory remains patentable. It ended Myriad’s monopoly on BRCA testing and the price that came with it, and it drew the line the whole synthetic biology industry now works against: what you find is not yours, what you build is.

-58.70000,-34.50000.name: Biogenesis Bago
-58.70000,-34.50000.desc: An Argentine veterinary vaccine manufacturer named among the principal companies in the global sector, with operations extending into India. It is the only Latin American producer in that group, and it sits in the country that also holds the first engineered wheat, the herbicide-tolerant soy that covers most of its arable land, and the regulator whose gene-editing criteria the rest of the world has copied. The animal health side of that same concentration is rarely counted alongside the crop side, and it is the same few kilometres of the Buenos Aires hinterland.

5.95000,51.65000.name: Institut de Sélection Animale (ISA)
5.95000,51.65000.state: Boxmeer, Netherlands — a Hendrix Genetics company
5.95000,51.65000.desc: The layer breeding arm of the Dutch multispecies breeding group, and the leading supplier of brown egg genetics, sold under a set of brand names that look like separate companies and are not. The group also breeds pigs, turkeys and farmed fish. Between it and the German holding company, essentially all commercial turkey and egg-laying stock and most meat chicken stock in the world originates from two corporations — a degree of concentration this map records nowhere else, including in seed.

5.85000,51.84330.name: Rewilding Europe
5.85000,51.84330.desc: The organisation that provides the land. Its 2015 partnership with the Dutch breeding foundation splits the work explicitly: the foundation runs the breeding, and this body supplies breeding locations across its rewilding areas and network. Herds now graze in Spain, Portugal, Croatia, Czechia, Romania and the Netherlands, with breeds chosen per site for local climate, forage and predators, and a stated goal of self-sufficient herds of at least 150 animals within about twenty years. Every other release on this map is a permit question — who authorised it, under which statute. This one is a land question: whoever holds the ground decides, and the animal is legally cattle.
